query: DO $$ DECLARE v_template_id UUID; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_template_id FROM public.inspection_templates WHERE code = 'government-hospital-accreditation'; IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE public.inspection_template_items SET sort_order = sort_order + 1 WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'B' AND sort_order >= 14; INSERT INTO public.inspection_template_items (template_id, section_code, item_code, question_text, item_type, max_score, sort_order, is_required) VALUES (v_template_id, 'B', '015_13_others', 'Others (specify)', 'text', 0, 14, false) ON CONFLICT (template_id, item_code) DO UPDATE SET question_text = EXCLUDED.question_text, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order; END IF; END $$;
